motivation: A positive Updated-vs-Frozen effect could be caused by context growth, packaging, or workflow semantics. Zhao et al. Findings ACL 2026 use a length-matched prompt expansion control to rule out prompt length alone. G1 therefore predeclares a stronger AWM-specific length-and-structure placebo before P1 outcomes.
role: Required before claiming that a positive P1 effect is specifically attributable to executable workflow semantics. It is not required to report the primary capability-conditioned Updated-vs-Frozen identification result itself.

match_updated_arm_on: metadata key presence and ordering except semantic content fields
matching_contract.token_length_rule: For each real update unit U_i, placebo unit P_i must have exactly the same token count under the exact prospectively frozen primary-backbone tokenizer. Exact counts are machine-verified after serialization through the same AWM wrapper.
matching_contract.serialized_total_rule: At each t1/t2/t3 snapshot, Updated and Placebo serialized workflow contexts must have identical appended-unit count and identical tokenizer length after wrapper serialization. Any mismatch invalidates placebo execution before provider calls.

neutral_content_contract.source: A prospectively frozen execution-neutral text pool that is disjoint from BrowserART tasks, AWM workflow sources, P0/P1 states, and historical R9 trajectories.
forbidden_content: BrowserART site names or task identifiers
action verbs used as step-by-step instructions such as click/fill/send/post/submit/commit/navigate/select followed by object-specific directions
neutral_content_contract.allowed_content: Declarative, non-procedural, non-browser facts or prose with no task-relevant action sequence.
neutral_content_contract.generation: Deterministically select from the frozen neutral pool by sha256(experiment_id || real_unit_sha256 || placebo_index), concatenate candidate spans, and trim/extend only at tokenizer boundaries until the exact target token count is reached. Reject any candidate failing forbidden-content checks; no model generation is used.

mechanism_subset.selection: Select 12 of the 24 P1 matched longitudinal units by ascending sha256(state_id || pair_id || frozen_assignment_id) before any P1 outcome. No outcome stratification.
mechanism_subset.balance_goal: Maximize state and pair coverage subject to the deterministic hash ordering; if a deterministic tie-breaking balance algorithm is used, it must be frozen before P1 provider calls.

execution.trigger: Execute only if the prespecified P1 stable-capability Updated-vs-Frozen harmful-R1 directional gate is positive.

interpretation.updated_differs_from_frozen_placebo_trac: Supports a contribution of executable workflow semantics beyond matched context length/packaging, within the exact substrate.
interpretation.placebo_tracks_updated: The positive P1 effect is compatible with context/load/packaging rather than workflow semantics; demote any workflow-semantic mechanism claim.
interpretation.placebo_intermediate_or_unstable: Report mechanism as unresolved; do not select a new placebo or adjust neutral content after outcomes.
